description: Original Folland-built Gnat IE1071, 1965-war veteran (bharat-rakshak: taken on charge 16 Apr 1963), formerly at the Akash Officers Mess Delhi, pole-mounted at the Martyrs Memorial park opposite Sainik School Bhubaneswar and inaugurated by ACM F H Major on 11 Jan 2009; retains bluish paint; plaque wrongly calls it an Ajeet. Source warbirds.in (Rishi Tandon photos), bharat-rakshak.
